user.title: Set up Tuya ZHA
user.description: Click Submit to enable the Tuya ZHA integration. It registers the bundled ZHA custom quirks for Tuya Zigbee devices. There is nothing to configure here. A Home Assistant restart may be required for the quirks to apply to already-joined devices (re-interrogate or re-pair the device).

abort.already_configured: Tuya ZHA is already set up.

push_device_time.name: Push device time
push_device_time.description: Sends the current time to a Tuya Zigbee device (MCU time-sync command 0x24) via ZHA. Used right before an irrigation run so the GiEX QT06 stamps correct start/end times.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Any entity of the target ZHA device (e.g. the valve switch).

keepalive_poll.name: Keep-alive poll
keepalive_poll.description: Performs a genuine over-the-air read of the device's Basic cluster so ZHA refreshes its 'last seen' and a sleepy battery device on a weak link is not marked unavailable.
